author_lane: requalify block_elite_bull on post-fix data (subagent, after-hours grind window)

population.window_rationale: corrected-feed era only: levels compiler v2 shipped 2026-07-27 evening; first corrected session 2026-07-28.
population.note: 131 = rows where action==SKIP_ELITE_BULL_LEVEL_RECLAIM; 141 rows carry the string in the verdict field but 10 cascade into a different terminal action -- mining uses action, same as bull_elite_atm_decision_log_mining.py (2026-07-22 precedent).

dedupe.per_account_event_clustering: sort by ts_et per account; consecutive rows with gap <= 5 min form ONE event; event ts = first tick ts (identical to bull_elite_atm_decision_log_mining.py DEDUPE_GAP_MINUTES=5).
dedupe.cross_account_distinct_setups: headline 'distinct setups' count merges safe+bold events whose first ticks are within 5 min of each other (same underlying shared signal); replay cohorts stay PER ACCOUNT because the gate and the counterfactual entry are per account.

exclusions_frozen.rule: cross-account SKIP_STALE_TRIGGER within 90s of event first tick => exclude (stale echo), same as the 2026-07-10 and 2026-07-22 studies.

trigger_bar_et date < event ts_et date => exclude as prior-day stale echo (a 'reclaim' of yesterday's 15:55 bar re-seen at today's open is not a fresh tradeable setup). New field, available post-fix only; excluded events listed in output.

event first tick time >= 15:00 ET => exclude from tradeable cohorts (entry_no_trade_after_et = 15:00 in BOTH params files; the engine would emit SKIP_LATE_ENTRY even with block_elite_bull lifted). Reported separately as the 'late cluster' cell -- shown, never graded.
event first tick in [09:35, 09:41) => KEEP but flag elevated_stale_risk (open-adjacent), mirroring the 2026-07-22 study; conservative cohort excluding flagged events also reported.

replay_method.strike: ATM: round(spy at event first tick) + 0, side C (mirrors 2026-07-22 study STRIKE_OFFSET_ATM=0)
replay_method.entry_premium: first cached real-OPRA 5-min bar with timestamp_et >= event first tick, .open; entry_premium <= 0 or no bars => dropped, counted in n_missing_bars, never imputed
replay_method.entry_bar_convention: entry+1 strict '>' via backtest/lib/exit_manager_walk.py#walk_exit_manager (ENTRY-BAR-CONVENTION-RULING-2026-07-25.md); the walk never evaluates the entry bar
replay_method.exit_shape: strategies.by_name('ribbon_ride').exit.to_dict() -- the LIVE core registry CONTROL shape (heartbeat_core.py:1983-1985 registers core entries under exactly this): premium_stop -0.20 (flag-off fallback), tp1 +100% sell 0.667, trailing lock 15%, runner_target 99, stop_mode structure, catastrophe -50%
replay_method.trigger_level: trigger_level_exact from the logged row (present on 131/131 post-fix rows; no recovery fallback needed)
replay_method.spy_5m_source: backtest/data/spy_5m master covering 2026-07-28..31 (SIP-append era per DATA-PROVENANCE registry)
replay_method.option_data: real OPRA 5-min bars via backtest/data/options cache; post-fix dates NOT cached at freeze time -> fetched via expand_opra_cache.fetch_contract_bars (same auth path _alpaca_creds.resolve_alpaca_creds, same CSV schema) BEFORE replay; fetch is data acquisition, not a run cell

qty_cells.qty10: ELITE-tier sizing, direct comparability with the 2026-07-22 mining study (QTY_ELITE=10)
qty_cells.qty3: min-size (Rule 6 floor: 2 TP + 1 runner) -- the sizing a lift-gate trial would actually use; PRIMARY for the verdict rule

cohorts_reported_all_cells: safe_sequential_hold (PRIMARY): events in time order; an event whose first tick falls at or before the prior replayed trade's exit_time_et is consumed by the open position and skipped (the core holds one position at a time); n, total, WR, per-trade, drop-best, by-day, half-split at qty10 and qty3
safe_per_event (sensitivity): every kept event replayed independently (upper bound on n)
late_cluster (E3 excluded): replayed for information only, clearly labeled UNTRADEABLE-under-live-entry-ceiling, never graded

fleet_real_fills_reconciliation.source: automation/state/fills-ledger.jsonl, arms safe-3/risky-1/risky-3 (ungated loose/tight fleet lanes), is_option CALL round trips, date_et in window
fleet_real_fills_reconciliation.pnl: FIFO within (arm, symbol, date): realized $ = sum(sell qty*price*100) - sum(buy qty*price*100) matched
fleet_real_fills_reconciliation.mapping_rule: a fleet CALL entry maps to the blocked core cluster whose first tick is nearest in time within +/-15 min; unmapped entries disclosed
fleet_real_fills_reconciliation.core_real_fills_on_cohort: core PLACED rows on BULLISH_RECLAIM in window (gate not binding, e.g. VIX outside Bold band) reported as their own real-fill cell -- found at freeze time: bold 2026-07-28T11:28:04 C741 VIX 18.38

old_era_evidence_cited_not_rerun.raw_real_fills: n=24, WR 0%, -$885 (all 6 arms, since SS-B 2026-07-09; core Safe subset n=8, -$312) -- bull-requalification-2026-07-22.md item 3
old_era_evidence_cited_not_rerun.mechanism_story_under_test: old evidence gathered ENTIRELY under the broken level feed (IEX premarket, fabricated PMH, stale levels -> bad reclaim levels -> 0% WR). Levels compiler v2 = SIP + shelves + weights; J's chart reads land on the file's shelves to within pennies post-fix. Question: do reclaims of REAL shelves resolve differently?

verdict_rule_frozen.PRIMARY_cell: safe_sequential_hold at qty3, tradeable events only (E1/E2/E3 applied)
verdict_rule_frozen.FLEET_cell: net realized $ of mapped fleet CALL round trips in window
verdict_rule_frozen.a_LIFT_GATE_TRIAL: PRIMARY.total > 0 AND FLEET.net > 0 => recommend unblocking elite-bull on ONE core arm (bold-2) at min-size (3 contracts) with forward kill-criterion: after n>=10 fills OR 10 sessions (whichever first), net < 0 => re-block. Paper-only gate flip on a paper account = covered by ratified paper autonomy (feedback_j_ratified_paper_autonomy_2026_07_01) -- does NOT need J unless it touches the 10 rules (it does not; Rule 9 satisfied: weekend, in writing, documented reason). THIS SESSION'S LANE DOES NOT EDIT PARAMS -- the rec ships the exact edit + revert for the conductor/J-wake to apply.
verdict_rule_frozen.b_INSUFFICIENT: mixed signs (PRIMARY.total and FLEET.net disagree) OR PRIMARY.n == 0 => keep gate; forward re-eval trigger: post-fix distinct tradeable safe events >= 20 OR 10 corrected-feed sessions elapsed (2026-08-08), whichever first
verdict_rule_frozen.c_AGAINST: PRIMARY.total < 0 AND FLEET.net < 0 => gate stays, question closed for the corrected-feed era at this n
verdict_rule_frozen.drop_best_role: reported in all cells; if (a) fires while PRIMARY drop-best < 0, the rec states this explicitly as a concentration risk marker -- the forward kill-criterion, not the entry bar, is the guard
verdict_rule_frozen.honesty_clause: n will be SMALL (4 post-fix sessions). Every cell reports n. No cell is presented without the old-era table beside it.
